_about: Hand-reviewed placements for resource nodes the automatic rules in build_locations.py cannot match. Each entry names an EIA-860 plant (code and exact name, checked at build time) and the evidence. Coordinates still come from the EIA plant record; nothing is typed in by hand.

RHESS2_ESS1.evidence: ERCOT lists RHESS2_ESS1 as a single energy-storage unit (ESR1) at substation GEORSO, load zone LZ_SOUTH. A public plant listing gives the Rabbit Hill Energy Storage Project (EIA plant 60649, 9.9 MW battery, Williamson County) the ERCOT LMP node RHESS2_ESS1. The node name abbreviates 'Rabbit Hill Energy Storage S...'.
